origins.section: 17.2 A Logged Message Gives Back the Bytes Only After You Put Back What the Log Masked
17.4 Each View of the Bytes Answers a Different Question
17.5 ISOUtil's Helpers Fail Quietly Where You Expect an Error

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-logged-pan: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-logged-pan: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-logged-pan: 17.2 output '(3) PIN block put back: 99 bytes, same as sent: false, field 2 on the wire: 411111______1111' and prose 'the numeric field packager doesn't check that a value is digits when it packs, so the message packs to 99 bytes, but not the ones that were sent' decide c.
recorded.prompt:q-debugfilter: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-debugfilter: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-debugfilter: 17.4's run with ProtectedLogListener in front of the writer shows field 2 as '411111______1111' in the <isomsg> while 'the image shows the card number in clear', and 17.6 says the image is a Dumpable that ProtectedLogListener passes through, deciding b.
recorded.prompt:q-stan-counter: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-stan-counter: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-stan-counter: 17.5 output 'message 1000000: STAN 000000' and the rule 'zeropad(long, len) keeps the last len digits' decide a.
recorded.prompt:q-flat-realm: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-flat-realm: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-flat-realm: 17.6.1 output 'protect, flat, realm filter, writer: (nothing written)' and prose 'no source, so no realm for (3) to keep' decide d; enabling a second realm changes nothing since the flattened event has no realm (short inference).

gates.says: all 12 of this quiz's discriminating readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-logged-pan:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-logged-pan:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-logged-pan:a: 17.2 (3) says 'the numeric field packager doesn't check that a value is digits when it packs' and the masked card 'fails silently', so no exception at field 2.
recorded.prompt:q-logged-pan:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-logged-pan:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-logged-pan:b: 17.2 (3) says '411111______1111 has the right length' and the message packs to 99 bytes, so there is no length error.
recorded.prompt:q-logged-pan:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-logged-pan:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-logged-pan:d: 17.2 output shows 'field 2 on the wire: 411111______1111' and only step (4), putting the test card back, makes the bytes match, so the real card does not come back.
recorded.prompt:q-debugfilter:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-debugfilter:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-debugfilter:a: 17.4: 'the image shows the card number in clear'; 17.6: DebugFilter's image is a Dumpable, not an ISOMsg, so ProtectedLogListener passes it through.
recorded.prompt:q-debugfilter:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-debugfilter:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-debugfilter:c: 17.4's receive event shows the message masked ('411111______1111') in the same event as the clear image.
recorded.prompt:q-debugfilter:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-debugfilter:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-debugfilter:d: 17.4's <image> holds the whole 0110 including the card, and the message in it is masked, so neither half of d holds.
recorded.prompt:q-stan-counter:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-stan-counter:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-stan-counter:b: 17.5 output gives 'STAN 000000' for 1000000, not 100000, because the long form 'keeps the last len digits'.
recorded.prompt:q-stan-counter:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-stan-counter:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-stan-counter:c: 17.5 shows the long form returning 000000 while only 'zeropad(String, len) refuses the same value' with 'invalid len 7/6'.
recorded.prompt:q-stan-counter:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-stan-counter:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-stan-counter:d: 17.5 says the counter 'sends its millionth message as 000000', a six-digit value, so the packager never sees seven digits (short inference).
recorded.prompt:q-flat-realm:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-flat-realm:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-flat-realm:a: 17.6.1's 'protect, realm filter, flat, writer' run writes the event although ProtectedLogListener changed it first, and the page gives the missing realm as the reason.
recorded.prompt:q-flat-realm:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-flat-realm:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-flat-realm:b: 17.6.1 shows the order protect, flat, realm filter, writer produced '(nothing written)'.
recorded.prompt:q-flat-realm:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-flat-realm:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-flat-realm:c: 17.6.1 shows this order produced '(nothing written)', and the 'protect, flat, writer' run shows the card masked when flattening follows the mask.

gates.says: each of the 4 questions keys exactly 1 of its distinct options and every option carries the sentence its reader is shown
each of the 4 questions cites a passage the ledger still digests to the value this exercise was built from
